verdict.rationale: Termius's own docs state that it converts a plain-language description into a shell command using AI. This directly delivers the story's core capability, and a separate help-center FAQ about the AI widget corroborates it. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how generation works (review or edit before running, supported shells, model and data handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command

citations.quote: Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command
Termius can generate commands from plain-language descriptions.
